name: popsicle
headline: comprehensive affiliate programs directory
short_description: A comprehensive directory of top affiliate programs and networks. Explore and discover the best affiliate opportunities to monetize your content.
author: jeeiee

sections.overview:
The Affiliate Programs Directory is a comprehensive resource listing over 190 affiliate programs organized by industry category. It provides detailed information on commission structures, cookie durations, and direct application links for each program, spanning e-commerce platforms like Amazon Associates and eBay, web hosting services such as Bluehost and HostGator, finance products from Chase and American Express, and modern SaaS tools. The directory helps content creators, marketers, and site owners identify monetization opportunities that align with their audience and niche. Each program listing includes specific commission rates—ranging from 5% to 40% per sale—and cookie duration windows to help affiliates evaluate earning potential and conversion windows.
Identify high-commission affiliate programs to promote alongside blog content
Compare commission structures and cookie durations across competing programs
Find e-commerce, hosting, and SaaS affiliate opportunities by industry category
Discover passive income opportunities for content creators in finance and tech niches
